title: Wood grain must run along the member (posts read as plywood)
summary: A canvas wood texture's grain is horizontal; on vertical posts it runs across them and they read as stacked plywood. Rotate the texture 90 deg on vertical members (rot: Math.PI / 2).

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

doc.when: Every wooden post, leg, brace or vertical board.
doc.avoid: One wood material for horizontal and vertical members.

problem.symptom: Vertical timbers look like stacked plywood or striped boxes.
problem.cause: The grain direction of the texture is fixed (u); vertical members need it along v.
problem.fix: A rotated copy of the material for vertical members.
